2610.10227.title: From Prompts to Trees: Effective LLM-Guided Tree Generation for Few-Shot Tabular Classification
2610.10227.paper_summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) possess rich world knowledge and impressive generalization capabilities, their direct application to tabular data classification is hindered by high inference costs and limited interpretability. In contrast, decision trees are fast and transparent but often underperform in low-data regimes. In this work, we propose a novel framework that bridges these paradigms by distilling LLM knowledge into interpretable decision trees under a few-shot learning setting. Instead of directly prompting the LLM to generate full trees, which is often unstable and inefficient, we develop a three-stage paradigm that prompts the LLM to generate rules and organize the rules into a tree. Experiments on multiple real-world tabular datasets demonstrate that our method achieves superior accuracy and interpretability with significantly lower prompting overhead compared to existing baselines.
2610.10227.paper_summary_zh: 雖然大型語言模型（LLMs）擁有豐富的世界知識和令人印象深刻的泛化能力，但它們在表格數據分類中的直接應用受到高推理成本和有限可解釋性的阻礙。相對而言，決策樹快速且透明，但在低數據環境下往往表現不佳。在本研究中，我們提出了一個新穎的框架，通過在少量樣本學習設置下將LLM知識提煉為可解釋的決策樹，來橋接這些範式。我們不是直接提示LLM生成完整的樹，因為這通常不穩定且效率低下，而是開發了一個三階段的範式，提示LLM生成規則並將這些規則組織成樹。對多個現實世界的表格數據集進行的實驗表明，我們的方法在準確性和可解釋性上均優於現有基準，且提示開銷顯著降低。
